entries.cf3e18d295ad14f5: It has formulated a new medium-term management plan that designates the five years from fiscal 2026 as a “structural reform” period, and has set out three business strategies: “Rebuilding earning power 2.0,” “Building a lean management base,” and “Strategic use of intangible assets (intellectual property and human capital).” In next-generation growth markets such as the advanced information (digital) field and the environmental harmony (green) field, it aims to shift to a business structure led by fine chemicals by linking latent needs identified by sales to research and development and advancing the early commercialization of high value-added products.
